name: Spooky Empire
blurb: A Halloween-weekend horror convention in Orlando with genre actors, special-effects legends, musicians and wrestlers for autographs and photo ops.

picks: Friday the 13th FX, Dawn of the Dead

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'NEXT EVENT! Oct 30-Nov 1, 2026 Orlando, FL' / 'Oct 30- Nov 1, 2026 Hyatt Regency Orlando'; confirmed via WebSearch (Hyatt Regency Orlando, 9801 International Drive)

notes: No og/twitter image on the homepage; cover uses the current (2026-05) pirate-themed site logo. Guest cards show only first names baked into the photo (e.g. 'GEENA', 'SUSAN', 'GRANT', 'SUZANNE', 'GENO', 'PAMELA', 'AUDREY', 'NIKKI', 'SAMUEL', 'SERGEY', plus one 'JAMIE' card and two unlabelled sponsor/vendor tiles) with no recoverable last name, so they were left out per the no-guessing rule. Full names were read from image filenames and cross-checked against press coverage (Attractions Magazine / Orlando Weekly) where possible; a handful (Harrod Blank, Mike Martinez, Jerry Wallace, Kevin Foster, Joe Sawyer, Jenna Jameson, Amelie McLain, Bennie Taylor, Cedwan Hooks, Gloria Gifford, Leo Rossi) have a confirmed full name but no verifiable bio, so 'known for' is left blank. 'IT: Welcome to Derry' cast members mentioned in press coverage (Emma Leigh Cullum, Chris Chalk, etc.) were not found as candidates on the rendered guest page, so they were not added.
